decision_rule.scope: exploratory pilot only; no adoption or matched-accuracy inference
decision_rule.pass: All 75 paired draws decided, no truncation or request errors, behavior correct_count >= baseline correct_count, and sum(prompt_tokens+completion_tokens) behavior <= 0.90 * baseline; report paired differences and prefill/decode/wall separately.
decision_rule.otherwise: No pilot benefit established. Out-of-coverage scores make pilot inconclusive, never incorrect.
decision_rule.amortization: Offline abstraction used no model tokens. Human curation cost remains separately reported; no fully automated pipeline-efficiency claim.

execution_budget.cache_policy: Disable cross-request prompt cache reuse or record cache hits and report cold/warm timing separately.

remaining_implementation: Review and commit the runner and launcher, provide rowflow-compatible literal shell entrypoint, and publish for keeper qualification; the owner must not run keeper dry runs.
Before grant: record verified SHA256 of model weights and verify immutable kernel manifest.
During each request: capture non-zero GPU residency and KFD process identity, complete raw response, usage and prefill/decode timing; cache_prompt=false or report cache-hit split.
Use canonical answer_scoring.score_response_or_error, preserving None/cause and finish_reason truncation.
Append native result per completed request, resume only matching plan fingerprint, terminate only owned server PID and verify death.
